framing_visual_review.criterion: One reviewer assigned salience from contact sheets without per-image predictions. Foreground visible means identifiable crop plant structures occupy a large share. Whole plant or plot retains nearby context. Small or sparse shows little crop detail against soil or background.
framing_visual_review.interpretation: Exploratory, subjectively rated and confounded by species and capture site. Keep all 146 views in the main cohort. No disease or plant-health labels were supplied.
